label: Environmental body
definition: Government environmental regulator or environment ministry/agency: issues environmental rules, enforces environmental law, publishes air-quality, emissions and inventory data.

label: Legislature
definition: National, sub-national or supra-national legislative body: passes laws; the body, not the gazette.

label: Gazette
definition: Official publication of legal text (regulations, decrees, notices): the journal, not the body.

label: Regulatory executive
definition: Executive-branch regulator that is not environmental (customs, transport, energy, aviation, maritime, occupational safety).

label: Judiciary
definition: Courts and tribunals issuing binding rulings on environmental or freight regulation.

label: Standards body
definition: Standards organizations publishing technical standards relevant to freight emissions accounting, vehicles, fuel or packaging.

label: Industry association
definition: Industry and trade associations representing operators: positions, interpretation, sometimes voluntary standards.

label: Treaty organization
definition: Intergovernmental organizations created by treaty (UN system, OECD, EU institutions in a non-regulatory capacity).

label: Research institute
definition: Universities, national labs and think tanks publishing primary research and policy analysis.

label: Data aggregator
definition: Aggregators and datasets that index across primary sources; closer to tooling than a primary source.
